newsitem.title: CANADA: METHANEX NAMES NEW CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER.
newsitem.headline: METHANEX NAMES NEW CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER.

text.p: Methanol producer Methanex Corp said Thursday that Allan Cole would replace Terry Duncan as its chief financial officer.
Cole, who has a background in the chemicals industry, was previously chief financial officer for St. Mary's Cement Corp.
Duncan, a veteran at Methanex, is leaving to pursue other interests. A Methanex spokesman had no details on his plans.
Duncan, a New Zealand native, joined Methanex when it acquired methanol assets from New Zealand's Fletcher Challenge Ltd several years ago.
The Methanex spokesman said Duncan's departure had been anticipated by some followers of the company but Thursday's announcement was the first official word.
